description.value: Joyce Way Market is a family-run convenience store that has been serving the Joyce-Collingwood neighbourhood of Vancouver for over 10 years. It stocks drinks, ice cream (Ben & Jerry's and Häagen-Dazs), snacks, and grocery staples like eggs, milk, and bread, plus lottery tickets and cigarettes. The store also offers in-store computer services including black-and-white printing, scanning, and computer use.
